content: Root cause: The use-after-free bug occurs because the `pid_show` function attempts to access the `task_recv` member of the `nbd_device` structure after the associated `task_struct` has already been freed. This happens when the nbd-client task has exited, causing its corresponding `task_struct` to be deallocated. As a result, accessing `task_pid_nr(nbd->task_recv)` results in undefined behavior, leading to the kernel address sanitizer (KASAN) reporting a use-after-free error. The patch corrects this by switching to using a `pid` field in the `nbd_device` structure, which stores the PID of the nbd-client when it is active, ensuring that there is no dereference of a potentially freed pointer.
